She was the deciding vote on Trump’s tax cuts for billionaires back in 2017. Less than a year later, she was a pivotal vote in Brett Kavanaugh’s confirmation to the Supreme Court. As a Spokane Deputy Prosecutor, I held sexual abusers, drunk drivers, and violent offenders accountable.

I've raised more than anyone else challenging Baumgartner - _overwhelmingly from grassroots donors right here in Eastern Washington.

I'm writing to ask for $3.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In case it wasn’t bad enough that Do-Nothing Democrat Rep. Wesley Bell is
propped up by millions of dollars from AIPAC and corporate super PACs — it
turns out his campaign manager has been attending a white supremacist
event for years.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-2-cb.o6ov0J&refcode=em20260730-38104&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38104%2E1203867%2E6BdANR ]A screenshot of a post on x from Ryan Grim (@ryangrim) reading: 'This
is absolutely wild: Wesley Bell's campaign manager has been attending the
Veiled Prophet ball for years. Notorious event.' below which is a
screenshot of a Facebook post from Khalea Edwards that reads, 'Turns out
Wesley Bells campaign manager is in the Veiled Prophet. Her & her family
have been attending their white supremacists ball for decades. She got a
whole album on her Facebook called 'Veiled Prophet Ball' & there are
photos of her dad going year after year. This the same secret society
actress Ellie Kemper was cancelled for in 2021 after being crowned their
'KKK Princess.' She publically apologized, admitting the Veiled Prophet is
'unquestionably racist, elitist, & sexist.'' alongside two photos from a
ball event.

The Veiled Prophet Ball is an infamous whites-only debutante ball that’s
taken place in St. Louis since 1878. Not only has Bell’s campaign manager
repeatedly attended it, she even worked for Trudy Busch Valentine, who was
crowned queen of this racist ball.

We can’t say we’re surprised. Bell himself previously worked as a campaign
manager for a Republican before deciding to run for Congress as a
Democrat, and to this day he receives financial support from Trump
megadonors.

Missouri’s first district deserves a real Democrat representing them in
Congress, one who isn’t bought by the pro-Israel lobby, corporate PACs,
and MAGA billionaires.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-2-cb.o6ov0J&refcode=em20260730-38104&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38104%2E1203867%2E6BdANR ]Help progressive champion Cori Bush take back this seat from Bell and
the far-right interests backing him on Tuesday: rush a split contribution
of $10 or more to her campaign and Justice Democrats before
tomorrow’s July deadline!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-2-cb.o6ov0J&refcode=em20260730-38104&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=38104%2E1203867%2E6BdANR ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

If you had told me a few years ago when I was working at my auto-repair shop that Fox News would write an article praising one of my legislative pushes, I probably would have laughed.
Well, wonders never cease:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Look, I’ve honestly never cared about partisan politics or playing games for D.C. cable networks. I’m just interested in fixing what’s broken, restoring basic accountability, and making sure the people representing us are doing their job.
That’s why I pushed for common-sense accountability standards for members of Congress who might be suffering from significant, irreversible cognitive impairment. In every real-world job I’ve ever had, there’s a pretty simple expectation: you actually have to be able to do the work. Either you can do it or you can't. Congress shouldn't be any different.
And I’m proud to be fighting for issues that so many Americans care about — regardless of party lines.
But the big national partisan donors aren't going to fund a campaign like mine that refuses to play by D.C.'s hyper-partisan rules. That means I rely entirely on independent, grassroots supporters like you to keep me in Congress.

name: Bayudan for City Council 2026
subject: Please help before the July 31st deadline. I’m $4865 from reaching my July fundraising goal!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bayudan for Council 2026
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tony-bayudan-1

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/bQAPdNK1Sk3?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
| | | | | |
Dear Friends,Please help before the July 31st deadline. I’m $4865 from reaching my July fundraising goal!This campaign is built on one simple principle: local government should provide **opportunity for all.** Today, families across our city are feeling the squeeze of rising housing, healthcare, and grocery costs. Young families wonder if they can afford to stay, and seniors worry about being priced out. Working people deserve a City Hall focused on making life more affordable while protecting the unique quality of life that makes Daly City so special.As a lifelong resident and the proud son of working-class Filipino immigrants, these challenges are personal. My family has called Daly City home since 1977, when my parents bought our home at the Top of the Hill. I attended our local schools and learned the values of hard work, service, and looking out for your neighbors.My career has been dedicated to serving this community. For the past ten years, I’ve served as Chief of Staff to San Mateo County Supervisor David J. Canepa. As Vice Chair of Daly City's Personnel Board, I’ve also gained firsthand experience in making local government more responsive and accountable. I know how to navigate government, build partnerships, and bring resources home because I’ve spent my career doing exactly that.If elected, I will focus on delivering real results that provides opportunity for all:
* [**Affordability:** Improving housing affordability, expanding healthcare access, and helping families keep up with the cost of living.](https://us.list-manage.com/eniqUTCVSYJ?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
* [**Public Safety & Infrastructure:** Investing in first responders, fixing flooding challenges, repairing potholes, and strengthening transit options.](https://us.list-manage.com/REe2IjIpvnS?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
* [**Family Support:** Advocating for a childcare center at Daly City Hall to support working parents and make city services more accessible.](https://us.list-manage.com/18pIdVzerLk?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
* [**Senior Care:** Protecting and expanding programs that help seniors age safely and independently in their homes.](https://us.list-manage.com/10w77LT_niJ?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)

---
Last night my Ford Bronco installed an automatic software update. By the next morning, it had quietly opted me into sharing additional driving data without asking my permission.Fortunately, I caught the change before heading out and turned it back off. But instead of simply being annoyed by another software update, I found myself asking some much bigger questions: Why does Ford need more information about how I drive? Who benefits from collecting it? ## Trump May Pull Blanche Nomination for AG
President Trump said Thursday he may [temporarily withdraw Todd Blanche's nomination](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ_GdF75bzEULiJFdF-ULiUa7AGcGM_KzO6Kt482r5D6SlfnnF9f8xfkkuv2Aw4MvNJc8X0WZMY2w1bpyBU4U6W6U0lvaiXF52yU6aXy0uo5QS7X7LoUVkSDtsOg_XB3o-m16fYAy10PanU-9kv0OPYAgMkmn3Cww2q6HD5vylutlVZqvK1jWq2OYDUMfnSjcApTZmq335Qr77iWi17YbpGOroSd-XEK-02YSZgJlvgx-GzCTD-pZM7xFGba6HHKSK1eVUaqnOsTT7kUin8kU0pyKVDjjhKYqVW85IYVGxRhppOpXcJOOQn7Xdu7MYMbXddCerxzKfnsvXBqOyCXf1D8XyVfwfwNAAD__90aibw) for attorney general and resubmit it after two Republican senators blocking him leave office in January. Sens. John Cornyn of Texas and Thom Tillis of North Carolina want the Justice Department to guarantee in writing that a $1.8 billion fund tied to Trump's tax settlement is [permanently dead](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLvO4yAUhJ8GOiIuNpiCYht32XZLC5tDOCsuESGJ8vYrp9kH-MvRSN_omz_X7eoxY7399gXciG2r8H5kGAP65m-1Fax-YKutppbDu_UcjucmudSMG6bEFjzmzzbR4CKABEXBCbPMk5VaSJrc7I2Z9qhD1HaPcd53sRttjI7LorkCiu6kcaOE4IJze4k2RCUOr4RfjJ0smTgEHK1f_jasI0HMn_aCfjlaodmlMe4Pon4RuRK5jgQJcz47ItfUCpxCRK4-FKz4GP2rQ-Q6W2uNFWz0Z7mzPft6JGD_jdnRev1UNjBnPAm0u3B_f5M2ZOK34vE7RMePnns5-S8AAP__-DSEXQ). That settlement also barred the IRS from auditing the family's past tax returns. The Senate Judiciary Committee [scrapped Thursday's vote](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unDAQBeCnMZ1X_mEXKFykobtpU6LBHoOjwYOMWXTfPmKbPMCtphjp6Jzvz9f0BYlSXn7Dhq5GnjJeB2GtWCZYMm8pQ02cOa9M4eJCwZ-TUeYlVSetngIk-p7aJriIaNA26HTXP9vBvLRpVqchWN2j917PHZhX772FYdYx2mcbEZrk7jTVWa2VVmp4xCFEqz1YDX03tINoFYZUuTz-csp1xUjf_Mby8Lw15NZa90PYX8KMwozXdT3y7O8V91-YcWdKNflDmDFwBgqylnPbhRk_V9a1IFTMh9xPIlk5BDkTZL_iIWGR_w3kwru8GfishySEN0qOsvgMz0GpZ9sUF_YrEaXj1YlWLRsk-tSsP7J9O_MvAAD__924kis). With every Democrat opposed, a single Republican defection sinks the nomination. Cornyn said the two are not the only senators with concerns. Trump called both men finished politically and said Blanche stays on as acting attorney general regardless. Waiting them out [carries risk](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAUBODT4A4LHo6BguJv3OVvt7QwPNtEGCLyEiu3XyVX2HI00jfS_Fznq085le2_P9DRWueC5yMjEbbZb6UeqXhKtdSy1xzP2nIMzxkEjFxoruQcfcrveeiiWxEBVYdOanMZLIwSut1ZNMZc_BLG0SxgYBEhaK8g2mDMarBL7qMJraQUUgjbrzauSgavpDfaDpYNAmOi2vpbTYV2XPO7vrD1oR5ddjvR_cHUPwYTg-k8zz6UJXxKBtOHZjAJzWBSgsFE7Xnc-ZJ9CTtyv_FYbzzUVt6FU8o5Pfqdjtw1F-_nN4-aDWI7fMrfQfrTSy8HvwEAAP__nkV7DA), since Republicans could lose Senate seats in November.
## World Cup Deal Sparks Euro Boycott
Europe's 55 soccer associations voted unanimously on Thursday to [boycott all FIFA competitions](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6xg8G_hIo27mzalRWDYnQgzDp5dy28f-b5CuiMd6eh836-v9ctTpvL86TecJfFa8DwyimBd_bPwRsULceHy4hxPrjmG9woGem0G7ewaPeVrbZs4J0RA1-Bsh7FrJ-gtNK85GQ-D7cM4wYAxjc66znW9N9YNXQRsaL7XzOCsNdaY6ZGmmJwN3lk_DlM7qdZgJOH6-MNU5IUpX_zB-gi8NXl-ieyHcj8ULAqW8zwfeOzlLhUsB4eA9Q7C9VKwrAoWigqWdmrHsRtbBcsbk9e_-Qoson3OOlHyOvC2o9ANf-i9suAh-luADu9d75U-XlDj3zfJpffsS1PnuJ-UMx39oFrz3Dzl75fyX2o_M_wLAAD__-9ijro), including the men's and women's World Cups, over a plan to sell part of the tournament to private investors. FIFA wants to spin its commercial rights into a $20 billion company and [sell a 20% stake to outside investors](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMZ2j9ZoEXLi4hu6_9kpk8Dr4YrwIm0S8_Ym8wtUjfZqZPz_jj4sp5udvt5KtgcdMn5KoVtpH98y8xuxq5Mx54eQ_vCc_HyMCPiR0UqvRu5jOsW28DURIuiGruv7eGnwobBY7QQ9OmzsY3yvXaTBzuIdetX7SANg20V4adFopUADmFowPWs1OK9d3pjWiBfKx8n77yzHXhUI6-U37bea1SXapdStC_xI4CBzyuXGpVyRwuGCBA3QCBw0Ch-koMVMpAoeDgpOV5cTnzLXK7zQ5H5u8bIkwyddRlky7TDG_yMsQg5OeXJKFj32mS2l267dPTCmWRydaeK4upm-x-l9vvi3-CwAA___yfYhn). The lead buyer would be a firm founded by Joshua Kushner, brother of Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law. European officials called the plan irresponsible and indefensible, saying it was hatched in secret. A source close to his firm said Joshua Kushner has [no role in the Trump administration](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOpDAURL_GZEZ-0DwCB5uQzaYboot93XjG-CLbNOq_X9G_MFlJRyrVqX9fyxeEGNLzL-xoqqcl4VUi1op5gWeiPSSogRKljaK7KEdnz0UJ1XMxcC0XByG-l65xxiMq1A0aOYyPblK9VM1mhlFbrUCN6uFWCdb22K-PFUQv9CS0aIK528SgpRRSiKn1k_NaWtASxmHqJtYJdKFSbr8ppLqhj296YW4t7U00W61HYfoPUzNT83VdrV3LbXFzpuY7MjXjmelASLyQtZj5iR74Sm9LtXIfPPAj3hRj5KXCD_KPLLfnwUN6YamUC_-msp3Af86yJcxMzU027rhCjKH0A-vEc4cQP8vqr-58GfU_AAD__2cljP0) and donates only to liberal causes. A boycott would strip Germany, France, England, and reigning champion Spain from the 2030 field. List: America's Top Dog Breed by State New data shows the in every state, and the map is more regional than anyone might guess. Eight breeds finish first somewhere in the country. Labrador retrievers lead in 16 states, more than any other breed, though that is still fewer than a third of the country. Chihuahuas follow close behind with 14 states. The clusters are striking. ## Paxton Suit Ends Endangered Status
The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service has ended [endangered species protections](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI5sQ8xSuNiGLttuiQwek5GMjTyzIdmvfyKR3g-8YqpzNbrn_r1NN48J8_rHb-D4GcuU4aAEzFCnrRD7HBJ4YvIRFmQEWitMRhkrVS9bPQWP6TV1TXCzCoNuwOn-17Ubrr3tmrtr9RJViAC2N2DDbIbBagUxqPaq56Vr0J3PVN9qrZXp9MWoMPRDjLPVdlGzF52CgFzqhe_A8PQU06s8oF6WsjXJ3Zl3Eu1vYUZhRvLZ5xVSSfiAMyHMeCp9kPwwYcZvAyXMmPxB_5DlXsu2M0nI4bwzXCFI2mFBoBMzLIwlywOI5buMTPjf19BUF_YDU0KyvejUunlM74b8s10fznwFAAD__2mVj48) for the dunes sagebrush lizard, a 2.5-inch reptile native to the Permian Basin, after Attorney General Ken Paxton sued over the designation. The reversal came in a [July 21 settlement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMhZ9G3q5A0YoVDxru4u126dDRYCzKESD_QGLi5O2LuI_QifwI4uDD-fMz_lDKaZ1_0cJeXnEbVz5qZhEu47JVoTVkpiqVIk9JEte58IiA3Re4r9aMgVJ-j7YJ_gahNw17464X219cZ5u7R-PMBP0V2bYThBAtI-E1ug7Asm2b5D9h4FpjDKA1GiH0ro_x1plughspCxySbEXLnYVfVGN-b08uetqWJvu7yF5V-61wUDgcx6HPJxLZysrvmVculPW8PRUONQlXhUPgSI8sCoeY8nlJC83nsheun_nR0uA0GoUXhN-S9kcm4fAPWSTzwquc-D0XPknvITbFh_1IOafaOWVhXijl01b-r-Onx78BAAD__2ObkHo) that vacates the 2024 classification and requires the agency to reassess the lizard's status within two years. Paxton argued the service ignored "the best scientific and commercial data" and habitat restoration efforts. "_Texas, its people, and its industries should not have to suffer the effects of an illegal rule while the Fish and Wildlife Service further evaluates the status of the species_ ," Paxton said. Conservationists say the reversal [benefits oil and gas interests](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGzpCAQhH8NZliAKGdAcInZXnqhNcrgUotgwbx19_36V-5feOHUdH_V3f9v8w1CDGn7Bztaevk8JzxrRCIs854rQXIRoVIFj2uggHUrOCuhBi4M7-TsIMT3rBtnF-FG2aCV5k-vx94MurlbY_pOiw6cH9y4eK9dr8QymFF03QJeNcFeMGE6KaVQWrZKuNGM3i-DHFaxANMCXaBcWroj4Quqj-_8xNKueW-ivRMdlXV_mZqYms7zbB9Ij-vJ1HS1YWr62JiaDnhRTjzCWb8C8aPk_aDKMTmePffosEC8TkgbFnS8HrgGrJeScKWQE_e58A-Px_ANxTE1NcW64wwxhjoYpsW2Q4ifePS7UZ9W_QQAAP__ckOPrA), with the Center for Biological Diversity accusing the agency of abandoning struggling wildlife. Oil and gas groups had warned for years that the protections would slow Permian Basin projects.
## Texas Cities Bookend National Safety Rankings
Plano ranked as the [second-safest big city](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OozAQBvCngc7I_2KHwsU1dLn2SjTgMVhncGTPhuTtV7CPsOVIM_Pp9_17jA-IKe7LX9jQ0TvkccejJiTCMm65Euw-IVSqEHCOFLEuBUfJpWHcMiVGDzF9Rt16N3HfixadsPeb7m_W6HZ1QWkwXBkIQcE0qftN60lIG3DueyV4G935jFslhOBSi05y39s-hMkIM_MJGs3RR8qloxUJ31BD-uQXlm7OW5vcSvSsjfrTyKGRw3EcXchvadb8VSnv51Ijh1PVyOE6Zz8OVmD_z2DL-8JgwxJnqOxkVmIX-Rra4vzziCnFamyj-bJBTFcy_a6vl5PfAQAA__91X4HG) in America, and Houston the second-least safe, in a SmartAsset study published this week. Houston recorded 11.5 violent crimes per 1,000 residents and a "very high" disaster risk. Elsewhere, Fort Worth ranked 22nd, Austin 26th, San Antonio 54th, and Dallas 73rd. Virginia Beach, Virginia, took the top spot overall, while Memphis, Tennessee, finished last.
## Thermal Drone Nabs Rooftop Burglary Suspect
A thermal-imaging drone led Woodway police to an [armed vehicle-burglary suspect](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHOozAQxfHTmM7IHhw7FC62ocu2W6IBD8Fag5E9CcntV-wVvvov_fT0_jzGB8YU9-dv3MjzZ8njTmdNxExl3HJl3EMirFxxoTlypPosNIICK5WTnR4DxvQdTRP8pEKvG_La3W-mvzlrmtUbrQJ2_WzN5ACcDU5buCHeNc4daNdEf2HKdVprBUa3oELv-mWZrLazmlAYRSFyLi2vxPTBuqRvflNp57w1ya_MRxXdLwGDgOE8z_bvyZ8rChguW8CgnIChU1fPOZz4lUdOcSb5qiR5pbJhkqHkneSMB78KSSwbBblQyrssOS8Chqb4cJwxpVitE0Y9N4zp_wr-2XdvD_8CAAD__1K9gso) hiding on a rooftop, ending a pre-dawn search in the Waco suburb. Officers responded to Topeka Drive around 5:45 a.m. on July 23 after a resident reported someone trying to break into vehicles. The department's drone unit tracked the suspect as he fled onto a nearby roof. [See the drone video here](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAURL8GMyxAhTEgeInZvHRDC72XkVoUC-4MM3-_5f7Cxt3Vfep83ee7CzEcj_9uR0tvn-YDa4lIhHneUyF3QERXqDiPa6CA5ZFxVkJpLgzv5AwuxM_cN2AXAaNs0EpzG_pxMLpvNjuIFTQOICSqGyhhvJdLB53pve60k02w15gwnZRSqF62SsBoRu8XLfUqFsd6gRAo5ZY2JHy74uMnvTC3a9qbaDeis7DuH1MTU1Ottf2u9L5CpqZXAExMTdcHU5MwTE2duHopQXUffqYYVuTPgpw2zLuLHHI6kK_upGdG7vKOwD3GdPCckmdqarKFs4YYQ9GG9eKxuxB_aehvDl9W_QQAAP__EamGFA). Officers ordered him down and arrested him without incident. Police [identified the suspect as Asiya Taylor](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u3CAQxfGnwR0rGPNhFy7SuLtpU1pjGHZRsFnBZH337aPNK6Q-0pF-_19f2xfmks_7Tzxo4e9Ut5OuXoiZ2nbUznjGQti5Y6KQOVO_N9pAgZPKy1FvEXN5b2aIy67irAdatJ-sma13ZngsyWqcJg0uOWsNeprtZMcIow_aWIQhL58z5UettQKjb6Di7OeUdqddUDsKoyhmru3GD2L6xp7Ku76o3UI9hrI8mJ9djD8ErALW67puvwOd_PrMAlZsnEMhAetHJmAtNWARsPKD2oFFxlZPklet8cK3fNaSA8lWa-L6lNgadZb7n3Yv2N4yny_qnO_IuZ4CVquUJHJRJTdJsKOWxjiU-5yCdPuEPgE65dXQlvi8cim5Oy-Muh-Yyz8A_1_21wJ_AwAA__-Je5cH) and found a ski mask, burglary tools, and keys to a truck reported stolen in Waco, with a loaded pistol inside. Taylor is charged with unlawful possession of a weapon by a felon, unauthorized use of a motor vehicle, and criminal trespassing. Officials credited the resident's quick 911 call.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: A great investment
body:
Let me explain why our campaign is a good investment.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&source=&t=1&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)
| | | |
---
I need your help, Peter. I’m still waiting in hope that you will [**make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina before tonight’s deadline.**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&amount=5&t=9&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)
If you don’t have anything to spare, that’s OK – but if you’ve been considering it at all, give me 30 seconds to explain why this is a great way you can spend $5 today.
**I’m the Democrat with the best chance in the whole country to flip a Senate seat.** Multiple polls have now shown me in the lead – in a seat that Democrats haven’t won since 2008.
My opponent has super PACs pouring millions (nearly $100 million and counting so far) into NC to support him. But I have people like you. If we can hit our $1.5 million end-of-month goal before midnight, we can stay on track to match them. If we can’t raise that, we won’t be able to keep up.
**One of the main ways we raise money is from emails like these, and all I’m asking for is $5.[So please, if you care about flipping a Senate seat, winning in North Carolina or taking back the Democratic Senate majority, will you help us reach our goal by making your first donation of just $5?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&amount=5&t=10&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)

Roy Cooper

| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk859&t=2&akid=2385%2E124072%2E1paxKA)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.
